<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Lower the given call instruction, including argument and return value marshalling.</p>


<p><span class="doxyComputerOutput">CI</span> is the call/invoke instruction.</p>


<p><span class="doxyComputerOutput">ResRegs</span> are the registers where the call's return value should be stored (or 0 if there is no return value). There will be one register for each non-aggregate type, as returned by <span class="doxyComputerOutput">computeValueLLTs</span>.</p>


<p><span class="doxyComputerOutput">ArgRegs</span> is a list of lists of virtual registers containing each argument that needs to be passed (argument <span class="doxyComputerOutput">i</span> should be placed in <span class="doxyComputerOutput">ArgRegs</span>[i]). For each argument, there will be one register for each non-aggregate type, as returned by <span class="doxyComputerOutput">computeValueLLTs</span>.</p>


<p><span class="doxyComputerOutput">SwiftErrorVReg</span> is non-zero if the call has a swifterror inout parameter, and contains the vreg that the swifterror should be copied into after the call.</p>


<p><span class="doxyComputerOutput">GetCalleeReg</span> is a callback to materialize a register for the callee if the target determines it cannot jump to the destination based purely on <span class="doxyComputerOutput">CI</span>. This might be because <span class="doxyComputerOutput">CI</span> is indirect, or because of the limited range of an immediate jump.</p>

<p>This hook must be implemented to lower the incoming (formal) arguments, described by <span class="doxyComputerOutput">VRegs</span>, for GlobalISel.</p>


<p>Each argument must end up in the related virtual registers described by <span class="doxyComputerOutput">VRegs</span>. In other words, the first argument should end up in <span class="doxyComputerOutput">VRegs</span>[0], the second in <span class="doxyComputerOutput">VRegs</span>[1], and so on. For each argument, there will be one register for each non-aggregate type, as returned by <span class="doxyComputerOutput">computeValueLLTs</span>. <span class="doxyComputerOutput">MIRBuilder</span> is set to the proper insertion for the argument lowering. <span class="doxyComputerOutput">FLI</span> is required for sret demotion.</p>

<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Analyze the argument list in <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Args</span>, using <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Assigner</span> to populate <span class="doxyComputerOutput">CCInfo</span>.</p>


<p>This will determine the types and locations to use for passed or returned values. This may resize fields in <span class="doxyComputerOutput">Args</span> if the value is split across multiple registers or stack slots.</p>


<p>This is independent of the function state and can be used to determine how a call would pass arguments without needing to change the function. This can be used to check if arguments are suitable for tail call lowering.</p>
